_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY -- this file is committed and contains no real data.
Copy it to data/subscribers.local.json (gitignored) and edit that copy.
Every swimmer needs a 'name'. 'team' is optional and only ever NARROWS a match:
it is checked against the team code printed on the meet's psych sheet using the
same matcher the relay code uses, so a bare LSC ('AZ') matches a zone sheet's
'Arizona' and a club code ('MAC-AZ') requires that exact club.
Use the swimmer's name as the psych sheet prints it ('Last, First') when you can;
a bare surname works too but is refused when it matches more than one swimmer.
